'''Molecularly-reinforced lines''' were used in [[Zone Control]]'s [[Repulsor Grappling Gun]]. Two hundred meters of the line were stored in the gun, and it was launched from the weapon attached to a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
